correctness.rationale: For an initial seed in an arc of edge length l, independent left/right Exp(lambda) frontiers give total event rate 2lambda until sentinel detection, including the duplicate-edge hazard when both frontiers target one vertex. For any direction prefix of length m the number of interior seed positions surviving it is (l-m-1)_+, so conditional R is uniform on 1..l-1. Summing over uniformly sampled initial vertices gives P(R>m)=n^(-1)sum(l_i-m-1)_+ and Poissonization gives the claimed time law and mean. The discrete second difference of f_l(u) is exp(-u)u^(l-1)/(l-1)!>0 for u>0, proving strict majorization optimization and exact tie cases including k=1 and k=n. Own independent exact full-state masked SI Markov chain checked 1782 event-tail equalities for n=3..8; the all-n proof is analytic.
